nodes.label: Slack Workspace
nodes.description: Multi-tenant Slack workspaces. Delivers message / app_mention / reaction events over Socket Mode and receives posts, reactions, and Lists mutations.

nodes.label: app.js (Orchestrator)
nodes.description: Process entrypoint. Loads New Relic, enumerates workspace JSON files, and instantiates + starts every per-workspace module in strict order (Stats first, then Reminders, Chat, Lists, Notion, plugins, GitHub sync, Web API).

nodes.label: slack-app.js (Slack Ingress)
nodes.description: Single Slack ingress layer. Owns the Bolt client, handler registration, event dispatch chain, posting, reactions, and metadata/permalink lookup. Modules also post outbound through this wrapper.

nodes.label: StatsModule
nodes.description: Starts first per workspace; provides the shared stats object every other module writes into.

nodes.label: RemindersModule
nodes.description: Reminder FSM: extraction, dedup, date extraction, scheduling, snooze enforcement, posting. Enforced through #MakeScheduledReminder / #TryScheduleRemindersAsync / #TransitionReminderState. Includes GitHubCommentRelay and the reminder-check timer.

nodes.label: ChatModule
nodes.description: General chat, thread context memory, and the CommandRouter registry dispatching admin/operator commands (RAG, model-switch, run-tests, restart, web search, rmm intent resolver).

nodes.label: NotionModule
nodes.description: Optional Notion search on app_mention events.

nodes.label: ListsModule
nodes.description: Slack Lists sync. Output-only shared list plus durable bi-directional per-user lists. One poll interval iterates all ListContexts with echo suppression on the bot's own writes.

nodes.label: PluginLoader
nodes.description: Loads enabled per-workspace plugins (from data/plugin-registry.json) and registers their mention handlers before ChatModule's catch-all.

nodes.label: GitHub Sync
nodes.description: Post-startup GitHub status synchronization across reminder modules, plus the delayed startup Actions-run summary message.

nodes.label: WorkspaceAI (Dispatcher)
nodes.description: Only supported workspace-scoped AI path. Model-prefix routing, per-channel model overrides, OpenAI Responses-API web search. Lazy-builds provider clients per workspace.

nodes.label: AI Providers
nodes.description: Provider implementations: gpt-*/o[n]-*/codex-* → OpenAI, claude-* → Anthropic, gemini-* → Gemini (direct REST). Unknown prefixes fall back to OpenAI. Shared schema assets normalized per provider.

nodes.label: Web API
nodes.description: HTTP management plane: workspace CRUD, reminder/stats retrieval, settings, admin auth flows, and normalized reminder export (?format=rebalance). Admin routes use session auth; others use a bearer token.

nodes.label: data/runtime/
nodes.description: File-based, workspace-isolated persistence: reminders, counters, enabled channels, stats, workspace config, channel model overrides, lists cache, thread context memory, settings.

nodes.label: data/static/
nodes.description: Prompt & schema assets, command-catalog.json, command-normalization.json, deterministic-responses.json, client-channel-mapping.json, generated HELP.md.

nodes.label: OpenAI API
nodes.description: Default general model (gpt-4o-mini), complex date extraction (gpt-4o), and Responses-API web search.

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.description: claude-* models. System prompt sent as cache_control: ephemeral for prompt-cache hits on repeated schema-backed calls.

nodes.label: Google Gemini API
nodes.description: gemini-* workspace models via direct generateContent REST, plus RAG embeddings (gemini-embedding-001) and synthesis (gemini-pro-latest).

nodes.label: Notion API
nodes.description: Optional Notion search backend.

nodes.label: GitHub API
nodes.description: Issue/PR status, Actions run summaries, and the comment-relay target for Slack thread replies.

nodes.label: WP DB Toolkit RAG
nodes.description: Optional external RAG backing the admin-only ask-woo command; independent of the internal RAG index.

nodes.label: New Relic
nodes.description: APM/observability agent, required to load first in the startup pipeline.
